what: The cut list of film B, with the opening of film A and the card loop. Made by npm run cut from film.units, film.beats, the narrator's film lines and the events of the whole film run in film mode. Frames are counted from 0 at film.fps.

lines.text: It sees unlimited PTO / and believes it. / The fine print / goes unread.
Step one. / Its own name. / Under fire.
The keys moved. / It did not notice.
A valid email. / Rejected. / As is tradition.
A phone. / From before it was born.
Its birthday / is now a gamble. / It loses.
Volume. / All the way up. / It will regret that.
The commute. / Two hours. / Each way.
The unemployment office. / Where it belongs.
A robot? / It says no. / It lies.
It fights back / the only way it knows. / Clicking.
